description: Creates the swap and returns the payment instruction: the one-time deposit address, the memo if the chain needs one, the exact amount in decimal and in base units with the decimals and token contract as listed by the liquidity partner, a wallet URI where a standard exists (BIP-21, ERC-681, Solana Pay, Monero, TON), and the status URL. Use it only when you control the wallet at fromAddress and will send the deposit yourself; for a person use swap_page_link. The deposit must come from fromAddress; a swap that cannot be completed is handled by support from the swap id. Floating rate: the final amount is set when the deposit confirms.

amount.description: decimal amount you send, as a string, within get_limits

extraId.description: memo / destination tag / payment ID for the receiving side, only where that asset needs one

from.description: asset slug you send, e.g. usdt-trc20

fromAddress.description: the address you will send the deposit from (a wallet you control)

fromExtraId.description: the sending side's extra id, only if your wallet attaches one

mode.description: standard (default), or private: the swap runs as two legs at two liquidity partners through an intermediate coin; the response then carries legs[]

to.description: asset slug to receive, e.g. btc

toAddress.description: the receiving address for the `to` asset

via.description: private mode only: the intermediate coin slug; omitted → the server picks among sol, trx, ltc; xmr on request (the hop runs on Monero)

name: create_swap
title: Create a swap (for an agent that controls the sending wallet)
